title: Normalization quotient at split nodes
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $B$ be a proper reduced connected $k$-scheme of pure dimension one [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension, def-weil-connected-scheme], nodal at every nonsmooth point with completed local ring $k[[u,v]]/(uv)$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Let $B_1,\ldots,B_v$ be its irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components], let $
u_i:\widetilde B_i	o B_i$ be their normalizations [def-sc-normalization], and let $
u:\widetilde B:=\coprod_i\widetilde B_i	o B$ be the induced finite normalization map. If $N$ is the finite set of nonsmooth points and $e=|N|$, then there is a short exact sequence of coherent $\mathcal O_B$-modules $0	o\mathcal O_B	o
u_*\mathcal O_{\widetilde B}	o Q	o0$ with $Q\cong igoplus_{x\in N}i_{x,*}k$. In particular $Q$ is supported on $N$ and $\chi(B,Q)=e$ [def-pc-euler-characteristic].

proof.text:
Properness includes finite type by [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Apply [lem-trf-normalization-singular-skyscraper] to $X=B$. Reducedness, algebraic closedness, and purity of dimension one are precisely its remaining hypotheses. Its componentwise normalization is the map $
u$ in the statement. It gives finiteness of $N$, a coherent exact sequence $0	o\mathcal O_B	o
u_*\mathcal O_{\widetilde B}	o Q	o0$, and $Q\cong igoplus_{x\in N}\mathscr S_x(M_x)$. For each $x$, put $A=\mathcal O_{B,x}$, $C=(
u_*\mathcal O_{\widetilde B})_x$ and $R=\widehat A$. The same statement identifies $M_x=C/A$ with $\widehat C/R$, where $\widehat C$ is the integral closure of $R$ in its total fraction ring.

Fix $x\in N$. Choose the stated ring isomorphism $\widehat A\cong k[[u,v]]/(uv)$. Apply [lem-trf-formal-node-axes-total-fractions] over the field $k$: it identifies this ring with $S=\{(f,g)\in k[[u]]\times k[[v]]:f(0)=g(0)\}$ and its total fractions with $L=k((u))\times k((v))$. By [lem-trf-equal-constant-normalization-residue-quotient], the integral closure in $L$ is $P=k[[u]]\times k[[v]]$, and $P/S$ is one-dimensional over the residue field of $S$ and is killed by its maximal ideal. Thus the integral closure $\widehat C$ of Step 1 has $\widehat C/\widehat A$ free of rank one over the residue field of $\widehat A$.

source.place: Tag 0C4A (lemma-2-branches-delta-1), proof Case I: explicit algebra of the split completed node.

proof.text: The first projection $\widehat A\to A/\mathfrak m$ is surjective: lift a residue class by the compatible residues of an element of $A$. Its kernel is maximal, hence the unique maximal ideal of $\widehat A$, since Step 2 identifies it with the local ring $S$. Hence the $A$-linear comparison $M_x\cong\widehat C/\widehat A$ in [lem-trf-normalization-singular-skyscraper] makes $M_x$ a one-dimensional $A/\mathfrak m$-space. That node identifies $A/\mathfrak m$ structurally with $k$. Choosing a nonzero vector therefore gives $M_x\cong k$ as $A$-modules, even if the completed-ring isomorphism twists $k$. By its stated sections-on-opens formula, $\mathscr S_x(M_x)\cong i_{x,*}k$. Substitution gives $Q\cong\bigoplus_{x\in N}i_{x,*}k$. An ordering of the branches only chooses the isomorphism; a self-node and a crossing of distinct components each contribute one copy.

source.place: Tag 0C4A (lemma-2-branches-delta-1), proof Case I: explicit algebra of the split completed node.

proof.text: The quotient $Q$ is coherent by Step 1 and supported on the finite set of closed points $N$ by Step 3. Apply [lem-pc-chi-zero-dim-support] with the given proper scheme $B$: it gives $H^j(B,Q)=0$ for $j>0$ and $\chi(B,Q)=\dim_k\Gamma(B,Q)$. By the description of the skyscraper sections in Step 1 and the finite direct sum of Step 3, $\Gamma(B,Q)=\bigoplus_{x\in N}k$. Its standard coordinate vectors form a basis of size $|N|=e$, so $\chi(B,Q)=e$. When $N$ is empty the quotient is zero and the same calculation gives zero.
